text:
lee: Heads up - were seeing a tiny but noisy rise in streaming reconnects + duplicate sessions for route=prefer-low-latency in eu-central starting ~03:10 UTC.

carla: any packet examples? sounds like late fragments again but on the websocket codepath.

lee: edge snippet (redacted):
```
INGRESS: write frame(id=frm42, len=16, head=true)
CLIENT: heartbeat timeout -> reconnect
INGRESS: flush tail(id=frm42, len=58) resume-token found
```

nate: coalescer writes head then tail later; resume token ended up in tail. client considered head complete and timed out. billing counted both as separate sessions.

pm-zoe: what are mitigations?

carla: short term: emit telemetry tag ws.partial_frame and mark session as provisional for 1s so billing pipeline can fold duplicates if resume token appears. long term: copy resume metadata to head fragment inside the coalescer and add unit tests.

infra-bot: alert: ws.reconnect.rate (route=prefer-low-latency, region=eu-central) = 3.8x baseline.

lee: can we canary the provisional-state per-tenant?

carla: yes. will flip feature flag for affected tenants cust-12 and cust-88 and add console annotation explaining the provisional window.

nate: implementation note: coalescer change patch 'ws/coalesce-propagate-resume' will set fragment.meta.resume_token = conn.pending_resume || incoming.headers['x-resume-token'] so the head fragment always has it. also add an integration test simulating delayed tail.

pm-zoe: timeline?

carla: PR today, staging run tonight, canary tomorrow 6h.

lee: ops - enable provisional flag now for the two tenants and add the console banner. monitor for 30m and report.

infra-bot: notice: provisional-session flag enabled for cust-12, cust-88.

lee: initial 30m results: duplicate session metric down ~60% for flagged tenants. keeping flag until patch canary completes.
